# Red Foundations — search crawler directives

User-agent: *

# Keep the free reader handbook (newsletter lead magnet) out of
# search results so readers can't grab it without signing up.
Disallow: /assets/downloads/
Disallow: /assets/mars-colony-handbook-red-foundations.pdf

# Point crawlers to the auto-generated sitemap.
Sitemap: https://www.redfoundationsbook.com/sitemap.xml
